description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Several transparent and reflective orbs rest on a flat surface against a solid backdrop. Larger pale bubbles recede behind a cluster of smaller, highly polished metallic spheres that cast crisp shadows. Smooth airbrush gradients and crisp specular highlights create a glossy, glass-like surface (derived from painting #153).
